
# Model set

All models are logistic GLMMs with a random intercept per document; they differ only in the fixed effects.

```{r}
library(tidymodels)
library(multilevelmod)
```

```{r}
# parsnip classification needs a factor outcome; glmer models P(second level) = P(TRUE)
sbc_tm <- sbc_noninit %>%
  mutate(has_overlap_onset = factor(has_overlap_onset, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE)))
```

```{r}
back_vars <- c(meanback = "mean_back", medianback = "median_back", modeback = "mode_back")

fixed_effects <- c(
  list(place = "place"),
  as.list(back_vars),
  setNames(lapply(back_vars, \(v) c("place", v)), paste0("place_", names(back_vars)))
)

glmer_spec <- logistic_reg() %>% set_engine("glmer")

# Formula preprocessors can't hold (1 | docId), so pass raw variables through
# and give the mixed-model formula to the model instead.
wf_set <- workflow_set(
  preproc = lapply(fixed_effects, \(fe) {
    workflow_variables(outcomes = has_overlap_onset, predictors = all_of(c(fe, "docId")))
  }),
  models = list(glmer = glmer_spec)
)

for (nm in names(fixed_effects)) {
  wf_set <- update_workflow_model(
    wf_set,
    id = paste0(nm, "_glmer"),
    spec = glmer_spec,
    formula = reformulate(c(fixed_effects[[nm]], "(1 | docId)"), response = "has_overlap_onset")
  )
}

wf_set
```

## Fit on the full data

```{r}
glmer_fits <- wf_set$wflow_id %>%
  set_names() %>%
  map(\(id) extract_workflow(wf_set, id) %>% fit(data = sbc_tm))

glmer_engines <- map(glmer_fits, extract_fit_engine)
```

```{r}
tibble(
  wflow_id = names(glmer_engines),
  AIC = map_dbl(glmer_engines, AIC),
  BIC = map_dbl(glmer_engines, BIC),
  logLik = map_dbl(glmer_engines, \(m) as.numeric(logLik(m))),
  deviance = map_dbl(glmer_engines, deviance)
) %>%
  arrange(AIC)
```

```{r}
sjPlot::tab_model(glmer_engines$place_meanback_glmer)
```

```{r}
tab_back_comparison <- function(b) {
  sjPlot::tab_model(
    glmer_engines[[paste0("place_", b, "_glmer")]],
    glmer_engines$place_glmer,
    glmer_engines[[paste0(b, "_glmer")]],
    show.aic = TRUE,
    show.loglik = TRUE,
    show.dev = TRUE
  )
}
tab_back_comparison("meanback")
tab_back_comparison("medianback")
tab_back_comparison("modeback")
```

## Out-of-sample comparison

Folds are grouped by document, so predictions are for unseen conversations (population-level, no random effects).

```{r}
set.seed(2200)
doc_folds <- group_vfold_cv(sbc_tm, group = docId, v = 5)

wf_res <- wf_set %>%
  workflow_map(
    "fit_resamples",
    resamples = doc_folds,
    metrics = metric_set(mn_log_loss, roc_auc, brier_class),
    seed = 2200,
    verbose = TRUE
  )
```

```{r}
rank_results(wf_res, rank_metric = "mn_log_loss") %>%
  select(wflow_id, .metric, mean, std_err, rank)
```

```{r}
autoplot(wf_res, metric = c("mn_log_loss", "roc_auc", "brier_class")) +
  geom_text(aes(y = mean, label = wflow_id), angle = 90, nudge_x = 0.15, size = 3)
```
